interpretation_scope: Dynamical intervention on the AdaLN action-entry path of one block: the update rule (shift/scale/gate) is rescaled along the throttle-brake contrast of the slices whose forward-AD route response is most hazard-dependent, gated by hazard-token content read at the block input. Fitted on discovery scenes only; descriptive selection statistics; the causal claim comes from the steered-planner table and the closed-loop label (Label-first principle), never from the selection score.
